result.instructions: Tools for Timetaag, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the leaves approved for next week and who is away."; "What is the leave balance of employee 101?"; "Show the daily attendance of employee 101 for November.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Timetaag data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timetaag_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timetaag_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timetaag_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timetaag_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timetaag_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with their branch, department, designation, location and shift groups. Working employees by default; set status to resigned or all. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/employees.

emp_code.description: Employee code, for example 101. Several codes: separate with commas.

search.description: Part of the name or code.

branch_id.description: Filter by branch id (from timetaag_list_setup kind branches).

updated_since.description: Only records changed at or after this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (company time zone). Use it for syncs.

tools.name: timetaag_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee by employee code, with the same fields as the list. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/employees/{emp_code}.
